messages:
mia: FYI I opened a concise docs PR to tidy up rate-limit header examples and add a tiny SDK snippet for parsing quota headers. Need an eng + analytics quick pass before merge. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1142

raj: Pinging. Can you include an explicit example showing how reset_in_seconds is computed from X-RateLimit-Reset (epoch secs)? People get confused about client vs server time.

mia: Will do. Draft snippet I put in the PR:```python
# client-side header mapping
resp = client.complete(prompt)
headers = resp.headers
limit = int(headers.get('X-RateLimit-Limit', 0))
remaining = int(headers.get('X-RateLimit-Remaining', 0))
reset_ts = int(headers.get('X-RateLimit-Reset', 0))
reset_in_seconds = max(0, reset_ts - int(time.time()))
```

raj: Looks good. Add a short note: "If client clock is skewed, prefer server-provided reset_in_seconds from response JSON if available."

sam: I ran the snippet against staging and headers look correct. I'll add a tiny test in clients/js/test/rateHeaders.test.js that asserts header parsing and backoff calculation.

alex: Heads-up: the dashboard nav link used in the doc pointed to /old-usage. I replaced with /console/usage in the PR, but infra needs a redirect entry. I'll file infra ticket if docs merges.

lina: Translation heads-up: English uses "usage tier" in docs and product uses "billing tier". I'll standardize to dashboard.billing_tier in the copy to avoid l10n churn. Marking as FYI, not blocking English merge.

jordan: Analytics ask: include the event name and properties we want documented (rate_limit.event: {client_id, route, remaining, limit}). Sam can you add the JSON example under "Telemetry"?

sam: Yep I'll add a short JSON snippet and link to our analytics schema.

docs-bot: PR #1142 opened by @mia: "Rate limit header examples + SDK mapping". CI: pending. Checklist: [ ] unit tests [ ] analytics snippet [ ] link redirect ticket

mia: Thanks all. I updated the reset mapping note and the dashboard link. If tests and analytics snippet land, I'll merge after CI.

raj: LGTM once tests are in. :thumbsup:

sam: Tests added and passing locally, pushed. Included analytics JSON and a one-line test to validate reset_in_seconds >= 0.

docs-bot: CI passed for PR #1142. Deploy preview: https://deploy-preview.redwood-inference/docs/pr-1142. Ready to merge.

mia: Merged. Release note: "Docs: clarify rate-limit headers and provide SDK header parsing example" under 2026-04-01 patch. Thanks everyone :tada:
